card.name: The word lifesaving, split after life
card.fires_on: The first piece " lifes" of the word "lifesaving", mostly in phrases like "considered lifesaving for the mother". It also fires weakly on a few other word starts such as "renal" before dialysis and "pro" in propranolol.

modes.label: Lifesaving
modes.description: The start of "lifesaving" when a drug is allowed only if it is essential.
modes.example: If oligohydramnios is observed, enalaprilat injection should be discontinued unless it is considered<< lifes>>aving for the mother.

modes.label: Other word starts
modes.description: Weaker firing on the start of other medical words, such as "renal" before dialysis or "pro" in propranolol.
modes.example: Do not use vardenafil hydrochloride orally disintegrating tablets in patients on<< renal>> dialysis

card.writes: It pushes the model toward the word "support" (and its Chinese equivalent), and away from words starting with "ap".
card.plain: It lights up on the start of "lifesaving" in warnings that allow a drug only when it is essential.
